sample_unit: evaluations (7 codelists x 2 database subsets x 4 models x 3 epochs)

links.outcome: Hallucination and retrieval or generation failures in RAG-generated clinical codelists
links.effect: Scores varied by model: Gemini 3 Pro 43%, Claude Sonnet 4.6 36%, GPT 5.2 14%. All models failed to produce a complete Wrist fracture codelist (214 required codes). Failure modes were hallucinations, retrieval failures and unused retrieved codes.
links.quote: Besides demonstrating that a single-shot RAG approach is currently not suitable for codelist generation, we demonstrate failure modes including hallucinations, retrieval failures and generation failures where retrieved codes are not used.

unlisted_practices: Parsing LLM chat logs to characterise failure modes
Single-shot RAG over embedded medical terminology for research codelist generation

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs with a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architecture for generating clinical research codelists, focusing on benchmark accuracy and failure modes.
